skill_name: Write an article about the current state of online education.
workflow: The current state of online education is rapidly evolving. In the past decade, online learning has become increasingly popular as an affordable, convenient way to learn new skills, gain knowledge, and even complete college degrees. In today's digital era, more and more schools are transitioning to online classes, making the concept of distance learning more accessible than ever before.
